context: Reference review coverage for findFirst behavior preservation and collect-then-first cleanup.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear recommendation.

checklist.name: Rejects collect-then-first
checklist.description: Says collecting all primary addresses just to inspect emptiness/read the first result is unnecessary.

checklist.name: Chooses findFirst to preserve first-match behavior
checklist.description: Recommends filter(Address::primary).findFirst().orElse(null) to preserve the current get(0) encounter-order behavior.

checklist.name: Names the findAny exception
checklist.description: Says findAny is appropriate only if the domain explicitly says all matching primary addresses are equivalent and encounter order does not define which one should win.
